title: Permutations and Combinations
description: How many ways to line things up, and how many ways to pick some: the counting behind every chance.

puzzle.goal: Each of n people greets every other person once. Write how many greetings H there are.
puzzle.name: Handshake count
puzzle.method: Each of n greets n − 1 others, but that counts every greeting twice, once from each side.
